title: Compliance Evidence Handbook and Acceptance Flow — AuthN/AuthZ & Keying
creator: Ava Martinez
description: This ticket captures a concise, single-source 'evidence handbook' and structured acceptance flow for sign-off on AuthN/AuthZ and crypto controls for Private and Dedicated deployments. It replaces ad hoc checklists with a deterministic runbook that maps requirements to verifiable evidence, owners, and test artifacts. Scope covers: SSO/SAML integration behavior and assertion traceability; RBAC role matrix and privileged role change controls; audit log collection, retention, tamper-detection and export; customer KMS/HSM key lifecycle (generation, import, rotation, destruction) and operator access controls. Deliverables: 1) evidence matrix document with required artifacts per requirement; 2) automated test cases and smoke scripts for each acceptance item; 3) gating criteria and sign-off matrix by stakeholder; 4) sample evidence bundles for two representative customers (VPC and on-prem). This ticket includes clarified scope changes from earlier draft: we moved HSM attestation proof and external pen-test evidence out of the first gate (now gate 2) and added mandatory rotation test coverage in gate 1.
acceptance_checklist: SSO/SAML: IdP metadata validation + assertion trace example attached (base64 SAML response) and IdP clock skew handling verified
SSO/SAML: SSO user provisioning and deprovisioning flow tested via SCIM or SAML assertion mapped attributes
RBAC: Role matrix published with least-privilege mapping and approval evidence from Security and Product
RBAC: Privileged role change workflow validated (approval + audit log + rollback path) with a sample change event
Audit logs: End-to-end pipeline confirmed (agent -> aggregator -> immutable store); retention policy enforcement verified
Audit logs: Tamper-evidence demonstrated (hash chain or Signed Log Root) and export to customer proven
KMS/HSM: Key creation/import test performed with audit trail and key metadata recorded
KMS/HSM: Key rotation test completed with zero-data-loss proof and application failover observations
KMS/HSM: Key export/escrow and deletion procedures documented and exercised (where allowed)
Operations: Runbook for incident scenario (lost HSM connectivity, IdP outage) exists and tabletop exercise completed
Automated tests: CI job runs acceptance smoke scripts and posts pass/fail to the evidence bundle
Artifacts: Confluence evidence bundle links and GitHub PRs referenced in checklist entries
